metadata.name: Golden Swap
metadata.description:
Found a second Golden Key? In vanilla it just vanishes. Not anymore.
- Golden Key while you already have one: you get a Golden Bomb instead. - Golden Bomb while you already have one: you get a Golden Key instead. - Already have both? Golden Key gives 10 keys, Golden Bomb gives 14 bombs.
Mod Config Menu (optional): Golden Swap ON/OFF.
